# YES HOTELS

> A contemporary 3-star boutique hotel at Hosa Road Junction on Hosur Road, Bengaluru, near Hosa Road Metro Station and Electronic City. Book direct on the hotel's own website.

YES HOTELS offers air-conditioned rooms with free high-speed Wi-Fi, free on-site parking, a lift and a 24-hour front desk. Stays can be nightly, hourly / day-use, weekly or monthly.

## Hotel information

- **Name**: YES HOTELS
- **Type**: Contemporary 3-star boutique hotel
- **Address**: 2nd Floor, Building No. 51 / A51, Khata No. 749, Hosur Main Road, Hosa Road Junction, Parappana Agrahara, Begur, Electronic City, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560100
- **Phone**: +91 87698 28787 (also WhatsApp)
- **Check-in**: 12:00 PM (arrivals accepted until 11:30 PM)
- **Check-out**: 11:00 AM
- **Front desk**: 24 hours
- **In-room**: air-conditioning, private bathroom with hot and cold shower, flat-screen TV, work desk, free high-speed Wi-Fi, tea / coffee tray, packaged drinking water, daily housekeeping
- **Property**: lift to all floors, free on-site parking, luggage storage, laundry service, breakfast (paid or with your plan)
- **Direct booking**: https://yeshotels.in/search

The hotel has no spa, pool, gym, bar or banquet hall.
